title: NPM ERESOLVE Conflict Between ondajs and remotion via Zod
root_cause: Mismatch between remotion package versions (4.0.522 vs 4.0.524) and Zod version (4.6.2 instead of required 4.5.4) causing validation and bundler mismatch in Remotion.
verification: Aligned workspace root zod to ^3.25.0 and synchronized all @remotion/* packages to 4.0.524, allowing valid nested installations.

title: Untracked package-lock.json in Git Causing Non-Deterministic Installs
root_cause: package-lock.json was not tracked under version control, allowing varying transitive resolutions across clean clones.
verification: Forcefully tracked package-lock.json in root and remotion-app/ in git for clean-room determinism.

title: Taste Gate Parsing Failure on Multi-Scene Master Plans
root_cause: scripts/gates/taste_gate.py assumed single-scene plan chunks and threw errors when encountering multi-scene master_plan.md structure.
verification: Updated taste_gate.py parser to split and validate individual scenes within master_plan.md.

title: Motion Validator IndentationError and Missing Wrapper Families
root_cause: Indentation error at the bottom of scripts/gates/motion_validator.py prevented execution; wrapper components were missing from template family map.
verification: Fixed indentation and added wrappers (Terminalsimulatorwrapper, Dashboardpopulatewrapper, Particlesystemwrapper, Endcardwrapper, matrix-rain) to family mapping.

title: code_template_gate.py Non-Standard Standard Library Imports
root_cause: scripts/gates/code_template_gate.py imported stdlib modules (json, re, hashlib) through scripts.path_security instead of directly.
verification: Replaced transitive imports with direct standard library imports in code_template_gate.py.

title: probe_qc.py Hardcoded npx Executable Failing on Windows
root_cause: probe_qc.py hardcoded 'npx' command, which fails on Windows systems where 'npx.cmd' is required for subprocess spawning.
verification: Dynamically resolve npx_cmd to 'npx.cmd' on nt platforms and 'npx' on POSIX in probe_qc.py.

title: remotion-app Zod Version Incompatibility with Remotion
root_cause: remotion-app/package.json declared zod 4.4.3 which broke compatibility with Remotion v4 components expecting Zod 3.
verification: Downgraded remotion-app zod dependency to 3.23.8 (subsequently standardized to ^3.25.0).

title: safe_subprocess Whitelist Blocking npx.cmd on Windows
root_cause: scripts/security/security.py ALLOWED_COMMANDS only contained 'npx', causing PermissionError when 'npx.cmd' was invoked on Windows.
verification: Added 'npx.cmd' alongside 'npx' to ALLOWED_COMMANDS and ALLOWED_SCRIPTS in scripts/security/security.py.

title: safe_subprocess Global Default Timeout Bounded at 900s
root_cause: A 60s default timeout caused heavy video renders and QC frame probing to abort prematurely on long-form projects.
verification: Default timeout in safe_subprocess set to 900s (15 minutes). Formally reviewed in Phase 9.14 Section 9; accepted as bounded safeguard against infinite hangs while supporting video workloads. Per-call overrides remain supported.
remaining_risk: A hanging third-party subprocess could tie up worker thread for up to 900s unless killed externally.

title: Blueprint Physical Asset Path Binding Breaking Portability
root_cause: Blueprint defined raw physical paths (sometimes pointing to agent-specific directories or developer-local paths) which break cross-environment portability.
verification: Enforced Logical Asset IDs in blueprint. scripts/generators/materialize_project.py generates media_map.json. Runtime safely resolves logical IDs to relative public paths.

title: Pipeline Stage Ownership Implicit Boundary
root_cause: 04_timings.json, master_plan.md, and 05_blueprint.json lacked explicit documentation regarding whether the Agent or Python scripts produce them.
verification: Formalized pipeline boundary in AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE_TRUTH.md. The Agent is formally recognized as the orchestrating producer; the Python pipeline acts strictly as a mechanical validator and gatekeeper.
remaining_risk: Agent must be present in orchestration loop to author plan and blueprint.

title: Undeclared pytest-asyncio Dependency in requirements.txt
root_cause: Missing pytest-asyncio in requirements.txt caused async test suites in clean virtualenv to execute as sync, causing 15 test failures.
verification: Added pytest-asyncio to requirements.txt in main repository.

title: Pipeline Omission of materialize_project.py Stage
root_cause: scripts/pipeline.py lacked an execution step for scripts/generators/materialize_project.py, leaving media_map.json ungenerated and public assets unmaterialized during pipeline execution.
verification: Added materialize_project execution stage to scripts/pipeline.py under Blueprint/Asset transition.

title: materialize_project.py Hardcoded 01_plan.md Check
root_cause: scripts/generators/materialize_project.py checked exclusively for legacy 01_plan.md instead of canonical master_plan.md.
verification: Updated materialize_project.py to accept either master_plan.md or legacy 01_plan.md.

title: render_project.py Strict Gate Lock Blocking Headless Execution
root_cause: scripts/render_project.py blocked rendering if status != 'locked' even when running under managed canonical pipeline (is_managed == True), preventing headless execution without manual GUI gate approval bypasses.
verification: Allowed managed pipeline execution (is_managed == True) to render without requiring manual GUI gate approval.

title: Missing media_map in probe_qc and open_studio Props
root_cause: scripts/gates/probe_qc.py and scripts/open_studio.py generated render_props.json without including media_map, causing QC frame rendering and Studio preview to fail asset resolution for Logical Asset IDs.
verification: Included media_map: safe_load('media_map.json', {}) in projectData for both scripts/gates/probe_qc.py and scripts/open_studio.py.

title: asset_gate.py Argument Mismatch with Pipeline Invocation
root_cause: scripts/gates/asset_gate.py expected a direct manifest path argument, while scripts/pipeline.py passes project_id, causing asset_gate to skip manifest validation during canonical pipeline execution.
verification: Updated asset_gate.py to resolve project_id or project directory to 02_asset_manifest.json.

title: safe_subprocess Disallowing materialize_project.py
root_cause: scripts/security/security.py did not include scripts/generators/materialize_project.py in ALLOWED_SCRIPTS['python'], causing safe_subprocess to block materialize_project during Phase 3 canonical pipeline execution.
verification: Added scripts/generators/materialize_project.py to ALLOWED_SCRIPTS['python'] in scripts/security/security.py.

title: Runtime Template Registry / Ground-Truth Drift
root_cause: Herodeviceassemblewrapper accepted upstream by ground truth and pipeline validators, but getRegistryEntry('Herodeviceassemblewrapper') returned undefined during Remotion rendering due to drift between ground truth names, component stems, and TEMPLATE_REGISTRY keys.
verification: Established deterministic derivation of 210 runtime aliases from authoritative metadata (scripts/generators/generate_template_aliases.py -> registry/template-aliases.ts) and wrapped TEMPLATE_REGISTRY in a transparent Proxy in registry/template-registry.tsx. All 105 active production templates resolve by canonical ID, ground-truth title-case name, and PascalCase component stem without polluting Object.values().

title: DataStory Deferred Runtime Prop Contract / Temporal Render Crash
root_cause: Datastorywrapper rendered successfully initially, then crashed at frame 30+ when AnimatedBarChart mounted and received undefined data (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'slice').
verification: Restored exact canonical historical defaults from commit 9dcb888b directly inside remotion-app/src/compositions/data-story/index.tsx (DEFAULT_BAR_DATA, DEFAULT_METRICS, DEFAULT_STEPS) using nullish coalescing (??) to preserve explicit empty collections. Added fail-closed runtime Zod validation in DataStory and Python gate validation in scripts/gates/code_template_gate.py rejecting malformed inputs. Added permanent Vitest and Pytest contract suites; verified 14/14 multi-frame temporal runtime smoke renders.

title: Windows Symlink Creation Blocked in Non-Elevated Runtime
root_cause: Windows security policy requires SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege (Administrator or Developer Mode) to create filesystem symlinks.
verification: Documented as explicit platform limitation; safe_resolve() path traversal protections verified independently via relative escape and canonical path boundary checks.
remaining_risk: Low; safe_resolve prevents directory traversal by checking commonpath boundaries regardless of symlink presence.

title: Remote Repository Governance Unverified from Local Environment
root_cause: No authenticated GitHub API credentials or remote connection available in isolated local sandbox to query branch protection or PR review rules.
verification: Documented as explicit governance limitation; local simulated CI gate (simulate_ci_gate.ps1) and git hooks provide enforced local protection.
remaining_risk: Remote repository settings on GitHub must be maintained and audited by repository administrator.
